skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of accounting, auditing, and internal control to understand practical issues in auditing and internal control at organizations.
Analyze and evaluate the strengths and weaknesses in auditing and internal control activities of organizations.
Demonstrate written communication skills to write reports and discuss topics related to auditing and internal control.
Work independently and in teams effectively and professionally, with high adaptability.
Show self-reliance when working independently and take responsibility for personal and group work.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on an objective and scientific approach.
